activeLimits.definitions: With fixed active positive-lambda rows and frozen q, J, R: S=J^T R^-1 J >=0; R_i=(1-d)/d*(J M^-1 J^T)_ii.
activeLimits.equation: (M+S) delta_a = -(kp P+KI S) delta_q -(kd P+B S) delta_v; geometric and Coriolis derivatives are intentionally excluded in this local check.

schur.equation: For semi-implicit update v_next=v+h*a and q_next=q+h*v_next, a sufficient frozen linear condition is 4*Mhat-2*h*Dhat-h^2*Khat positive definite, with nonnegative damping/stiffness.
schur.derivation: The eigenmode polynomial is m*(z-1)^2+h*d*(z-1)+h^2*k*z=0 after multiplying by the complex eigenvector conjugate; m>0,d>=0,k>=0. Jury conditions use 4m-2hd-h^2k>0. Zero restoring/damping directions can retain neutral z=1; no claim of asymptotic stability in saturated free directions.
